name: Karl Marx
summary: Analytical and detail-oriented Data Analyst with 5+ years of experience in data collection, processing, and visualization. Proficient in statistical analysis and data interpretation with strong problem-solving skills. Seeking to leverage expertise in data analytics to drive business outcomes and inform strategic decisions.

description: Developed data models and analytics solutions to improve business processes.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and provided actionable insights.
Created engaging data visualizations using Tableau and Power BI to present findings to stakeholders.
Assisted in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing data sets to identify trends.
Supported senior analysts in preparing reports and presentations for client meetings.
Conducted exploratory data analysis to uncover valuable insights and supported data-driven decision making.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Developed an interactive dashboard for visualizing sales performance across multiple regions.
Conducted a comprehensive analysis of customer behavior to identify key factors influencing purchase decisions.
